newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dana says new pipeline speeds Russian output.
newsitem.headline: Dana says new pipeline speeds Russian output.

text.p: Irish-based oil company Dana Petroleum said on Thursday that first oil production from its Sortymskoye field in Russia would be accelerated by some 18 months after a new pipeline from the field was completed.
"Oil will now start flowing before the year end," Dana said in a statement.
The new pipeline connects the two oil wells at Sortymskoye to the export pipeline at the giant Mamontovskoye oil field, Dana said.
Dana owns a 30 percent share of the reserves at Sortymskoye, its second oil project in West Siberia. Its partners in the field are led by YUKOS, Russia's second largest oil producer.

Dana said the first well at Sortymskoye was recently tested at 1,100 barrels a day of medium gravity crude from the primary reservoir. The second well was previously tested at 450 barrels of oil a day in the primary reservoir.
